Compared to other rare metals, which have at most a melting point around 5,000 degrees Celsius, magisteel can withstand temperatures close to 10,000 degrees Celsius. Equipment.title: Equipment

infobox.title: Equipment
infobox.Anime: Episode 4:In the Kingdom of the Dwarves

Equipment Enhancement: In a world wheremagicis publicly available, there are various ways for craftsmen to enhance the equipment they made.
Enchantment: By usingEngraving magic｢刻印魔法,kokuin mahō｣, craftsmen can affix magical effects to equipment. Engraved magic gear could be infused withMana, and once infused, it was possible to execute certain magic. However, there was a limit to the number of varying magics that could be enchanted. At most, only two types of different magic could be enchanted. Moreover, it was impossible to remove the engraving after enchanting.
The Eastern Empire utilized this principle to create magic stone-powered weapons that could be used by everyone, resulting in obsolescence ofGadra'sMagic Division.
Slotting: A new way of enhancing equipment invented byKurobeandKaijin, based on Rimuru's idea. By punching holes into equipment,Blade Cores｢刀の核,burēdo koa｣(magic marbles imbued with the power ofElementals) can be inserted into these slots, granting the equipment magic properties.

Inserting Blade Cores in different combinations can yield vastly different and unexpected results. For example, inserting aWaterElemental core next to afireElemental one reduces power, but having one Water Elemental core paired with two Fire Elemental cores increases power tenfold.
Grading: Equipment can be classified based on its quality andExistence valueinto the following grades:Normal｢一般級,nōmaru｣,Special｢特上級,supesharu｣,Rare｢希少級,rea｣,Unique｢特質級,yunīku｣,Legend｢伝説級,rejendo｣, andGod｢神話級,gozzu｣.
Notable Materials: There are some notable materials used in series to craft equipment with higher quality.
Monster Parts: Body parts and substances from monsters could be used to create high quality equipment. For example, Youm's armor is created out ofKnight spider's exoskeleton, and scales fromCharybdiscan be used to create armors and weapons with powerful magical properties.
Magisteel: Magisteel｢魔鋼,makō｣is metal refined fromMagic ore. It is highly heat resistant, durable, and excellent in conducting magic, hence very suitable for producing high quality equipment. However, it is also very expensive due to its scarcity, costing more than 20 times as much as gold of the same weight.
Mithril: Mithril｢魔銀,misuriru｣is an alloy created by combining magisteel with silver. Weapons made of mithril are particularly effective against undead monsters. Known equipment made of mithril includes armor gifted to Jinrai by Rimuru and Minos Bardiche found in the dungeon.
Orichalcum: Orichalcum｢神輝金鋼,oriharukon｣is a gold-colored alloy created by combining magisteel with gold. It is superior to magisteel in all aspects, including thermal properties, toughness and magical properties.
Adamantite: Adamantite｢生体魔鋼,adamantaito｣is a sort of bio magi-steel on the level of orichalcum that is quite literally alive and bonds to its user.
Dragotite: Dragotite｢竜気魔鋼,doragotaito｣is adamantite that has been mutated by aTrue Dragon'sAura. It shares all the properties of Adamantite but is considerably stronger.
Hihi'irokane: Hihi'irokane｢究極の金属,hihīrokane｣is formed after exposing magisteel to concentrated magicules for thousands of years (or special conditions like Rimuru'sStomach), this is the material spoken of only in fairytales and myth.

Equipment made of Hihi'irokane, only responds to mana from the owner it recognizes and will block out all wavelengths, even attempts to analyze it will utterly fail. Anything made of this legendary metal can be expected to be top of the line Legend-grade goods bordering on, if not in, God-grade.
Holy Weapon: Holy Weapons｢聖属武器,hōrī wepon｣are weapons enchanted withHoly magic.
Magic Weapon: Magic Weapons｢魔法武器,majikku wepon｣are weapons enchanted withAspectual magic.

Potion.title: Potion
Potion.summary: Dwargonused to be the leading manufacturer of potions, butTempesthas since taken that title after they developed the technology and infrastructure to mass-produce them, making it one of their major exports.

Summary: Dwargonused to be the leading manufacturer of potions, butTempesthas since taken that title after they developed the technology and infrastructure to mass-produce them, making it one of their major exports.
Types: Potions are categorized into three types according to their potency. Lower level potions can be created by diluting superior ones, and usingmagicule-rich water for dilution can double the yield.
Low Potion: Low Potions｢下位回復薬,rō pōshon, lit. "Low-Rank Recovery Medicine"｣are the cheapest and least potent potions around, able to heal minor to moderate injuries. These potions can be produced by diluting High Potions five times and cost foursilver coinseach when sold in retail.
High Potion: High Potions｢上位回復薬,hai pōshon, lit. "High-Rank Recovery Medicine"｣have the potency somewhere in the middle, able to heal major injuries with the exception of lost limbs. They can be produced by diluting Full Potions 20 times, or attaining a 98% essence extraction from hipokute herbs. This is the highest tier of potion thedwarvescould produce prior to the rise of Tempest. They cost 35 silver coins each in retail.
Full Potion: Full Potions｢完全回復薬,furu pōshon, lit. "Perfect Recovery Medicine"｣are the most potent among potion and sometimes calledElixir｢蘇生薬,erikusā, lit. "Revival Medicine"｣, able to heal fatal injuries and restore lost limbs, even if the limb in question was lost long ago and became a stump. They can even restore damagedweaponsmade ofmagisteeland its evolutions. They are created by attaining an extraction rate of 99% from Hipokute herbs, a feat unheard of beforeRimuru TempestandVestadeveloped the process. For unknown reasons, the 1% difference in extraction efficiency results in a difference of 20 times in healing potency.

For a time, it was unknown that potion extraction in a vacuum environment was the key to breaking the 1% barrier. Producing one of these without the aid ofskillswould take one full day. These potions are not sold openly on the market, and would cost at least 5gold coinseach when purchased through special means.
Usage & Limitations: Potions can be drank or applied directly on wounds to take effect. Upon application, wounds are healed instantly without leaving even a scar. Full Potions are able to read the consumer's original body structure and reconstruct lost limbs out of magicules, irrespective of the time they were lost. Almost all living organisms can be healed using potions, and Full Potions can even regenerate damaged weapons made of magisteel and its evolutions.

However, since potions are magicule-based, they cannot heal people with a resistance to them likeHinata Sakaguchi, whose constitution automatically purifies magicules upon contact. InExtra: Rimuru's Glamorous Life as a Teacher, Part 1, it was established that potions promote rapid cell growth, even malignant ones, hence people with malignant tumor might die when potions are used on them. Likewise, since potions simply restore tissue damage, they cannot fully cure diseases; the pathogen causing the disease remains, with the potion simply restoring the strength of the sick body. Another issue is that potions don't work quite as well for high-levelmagical beings, whose magicule capacities go way beyond what a single potion can replenish.[1]If an attack imbued with thespaceelementcauses an injury, the element needs to be removed first for any potion to take effect.
Trivia: Tempest, as of the events ofHuman-Monster Interaction, is able to produce 1 full potion per day, equivalent to 20 high potions or 100 low potions. Though it needs to be noted that the process involves using magicule-rich water.Rimuru also stated that they could have likely increased daily output by 3 times, meaning 3 full potions a day, equivalent to 60 high potions or 300 low potions. That has yet to be put into practice though, due to no pressing need.

There is also a small bathroom with a shower and toilet, a small kitchen set with a stove and refrigerator, some ceiling lights, a set of wall hooks, and a few closets. A large table and seat are also placed at the front for Gale to watch his Beast Gnome through the front window as it pulls the carriage.[2]
Background: To help Class S with their upcoming outdoor training exam, Rimuru returned toTempestto have their subordinates construct a special carriage called the camping car. Class S was very amazed by the carriage's unusual design.[1]Since Rimuru isn't allowed to directly help Class S with their exam, Gale decides to have his Beast Gnome pull the carriage. Shortly before the exam, the other students from different classes and Tiss were amazed by Class S's carriage, thoughJeff Segalis not. Tiss accompanied Class S to the Town of Guratol, taking notes of their progress. At one point, Tiss took a shower, which forced the boys to wear blindfolds (except Gale, who still had to watch his Beast Gnome).[2]Arriving atCount Guratol's mansion much earlier than expected, they travel to nearby caves for the next part of their exam. Following an unplanned confrontation with thieves and aPhantomCommanding officer,[3]they returned to Count Guratol's mansion, with the second part of the exam being canceled.[3]After the exam, Class S made their journey back to the Freedom Academy.
During Rimuru's trip toColeus, he andPauluse the camping car to travel to an inn. It is unknown what happened to the camping car after that.

Nasca Namrium Ulmeria United Eastern Emp.title: Nasca Namrium Ulmeria United Eastern Empire/Military

Philosophy & Structure: The supreme decision-making power of the military did not belong to the nation, but the emperor. All of the Empire’s military power was centered on the emperor. The highest ranking officer within the military is the Marshal, which is in factVelgryndherself. Following the marshal are the three Generals commanding each division, selected after discussions held within the marshal, the emperor, andGadra. These appointed generals will then be givenGod-gradeequipment.

The Empire's only creed "Power is Everything," allows anyone to achieve greatness as long as they are powerful. Individuals could climb the rank through rank battles within the military. So long as the battle was supervised by a neutral third party, this system allowed a lower-ranking individual to challenge his superior. In other words, it allowed insubordination. As a result, ranks within the divisions often fluctuated.

Naturally, several conditions had to be met for these rank battles to be approved. They could not be held during a military operation. It would be rendered invalid without the presence of a witness. Moreover, if the challenging party were defeated, they would need to wait another year before regaining the right to challenge. The same rule applied if the challenger killed their opponent.

Since superior officers were allowed to kill their challengers, these challenges had to be treated with caution. The challenger had to utilize an overwhelming amount of strength in order to make their opponent admit defeat.
Military Strength: The Empire's military is separated into several divisions below:
Armored Division: The Armored Division, commanded byCalgurio, is where science and technology of the different worlds were fused with magic technology, it is the largest division with more than 2 million soldiers, 1 million of which could be deployed immediately for invasion. The breakdown of the deployable units are as per follows:
Restructured Armor Corps: These were soldiers who had adopted the otherworldly technology and underwent magical modifications, allowing them to survive 7 days without eating and drinking. Their individual combat capability was at least ranked C+, and the elite among them even reached rank A. There were 700,000 of them.
Magitank Force: Commanded by Lieutenant GeneralGaster, this unit possessed 2,000 magitanks, a new weapon they had put into practical use. The magitank, operated by five people, is an unprecedented war machine that revolutionized the concept of battle. The main armament of the tanks, named magic cannon, had a caliber of 120mm and muzzle velocity of 2,000 meters per second. It had a 50-round capacity and could fire five rounds per minute. Its power was tremendous, being able to unleash destruction equivalent to tactical-class super-high explosive magic. Incidentally, although they are fired based on magic principles, the shell itself is a simple lump of iron. It is a formidable kinetic projectile that could easily penetrate both anti-magic barriers and anti-archer defenses. The number of troops, including the maintenance team, was 200,000.
Flying Combat Corps: Commanded by Major GeneralFarraga, they had 400 airships and were the pride of the Empire, the fruit of the otherworldly knowledge. Each craft could carry a maximum of 400 passengers. Of them, 50 are vital maintenance crew required to operate the ship, while the remaining crew would be engaged in defensive magic or gunning. The airships are equipped with a large number of magically enhanced guns, making them excellent warships for both offense and defense. They are also useful as a means of transportation, making it possible to transport a large number of troops and catching the enemy off guard with a pincer attack. The division numbered 100,000 troops, most of which belonged to the formerMagic Division.
Magic Beast Division: The Magic Beast Division, commanded byGradim, is the successful product of biotechnology. Utilizing DNA analysis (technology from another world), it became possible to nurture and raise magic beasts, turning them into powerful beast knights. Moreover, their riders are carefully selected warriors with powers of ancient champions (analyzed with DNA technology) awakened within them. This is a rare quality available only in 1 out of 100,000 people.

Each beast knights are ranked A- and above by itself, and the combined strength of magic beast and riders is impossible to gauge. Despite having only 30,000 members, it is the one of the most elite unit the Empire has to offer.
Composite Division: The Composite Division commanded byYuuki Kagurazakawas a hodgepodge, but had a lot of potential. It was a den of misfits, singled out due to their inability to cooperate in groups—at least, that was how the public perceived them. But on a closer look, that was hardly accurate. The reason why the division members could not coordinate well with others was because of the fact that each and every one of them possessed extraordinary abilities. So outstanding were their abilities, in fact, that managing those guys was difficult.

Many of its members wereotherworlderswhose potential was completely unknown. Due to various experiments that were being carried out inside the division, there were also individuals who awoke powers beyond belief that could not be reproduced—they became magic beasts, boasting strength beyond A rank. While troublesome to control, they were outstanding warriors. Among them were also human weapons that obtained their power from unknown sources, and as such, many products of experiments were gathered under that banner.

In the past, they were simply being managed and kept in line, but now with Yuuki as their leader, the division suddenly emerged as an extraordinarily powerful trump card within the army. The total number of soldiers was around 200,000, half of which were officers and non-combatants, leaving around 100,000 troops that made up the actual combat force. Within it was also a hand-picked platoon of elite members that worshipped Yuuki. These individuals became the pillars of the Composite Division.
Imperial Guardians: This is the group directly under the emperor's command, carefully selected from the other divisions. Despite having only 100 members, their combined strength is greater than the three remaining divisions combined. The members are called "Imperial Guardians" and every one of them are at least at the level ofEnlightenedin strength. All of them were giftedLegend-gradeequipment as a testament of their strength.

Each one of them have the rank of a senior officer. When they carry out special missions, they're granted the authority of a colonel, at minimum. These powerful warriors are ranked by numbers according to their strength and their ranks are determined by rank battles, in which those who ranked 30 and below are significantly more powerful than those above. The "Double 0 Numbers" (ranks 001-009) are on yet another level in terms of power, who are all at the level ofSaints.

Abilities: In addition to the advantages of being aGenesis-gradeweapon with anExistence valueof tens of millions, whenTrue Dragon Nucleationis performed, theTrue Dragonthat is turned into aTrue Dragon Core｢竜種核,ryūshukaku｣can be inserted into one of the sword's hole openings and the True Dragon's full power can be wielded as a weapon. Elpis has four hole openings, and so a maximum of four True Dragon Cores can be used at once. However, the amount of hole openings increased from two to three to four, so even if there was a fifth or more True Dragon Cores, Elpis would likely simply increase the amount of hole openings again, so it's likely a maximum amount of hole openings doesn't exist.
Trivia: The name Elpis is derived from that of theeponymous Greek goddessof hope.
Elpis is the only known weapon to have "evolved" into a Genesis-grade rather than being "created" as one.

Dragon Slayer.title: Dragon Slayer

Abilities: Dragon Slayer is a straight-blade greatsword made to suit Youm's fighting style and is especially designed to be effective againstmonsterswith large bodies. One side of the blade has a fine edge that is well sharpened and designed to cut through flesh; while the other side is exceptionally sturdy and designed for crushing through a target's defenses.[1]
It's capable of cutting through even aKnight spider's steel-like carapace with relative ease.[1]
